$comment: Newer-Blender features Angelo adopted before its base ships them (AGENTS.md, 'Newer Blender first'; scripts/angelo/upstream_early.py documents the fields). At each base move, upstream_overlap.py early lists every item against the new base and the merge records keep ours, take theirs or merge, judged on quality, latency and cost.

items.title: WM_jobs_has_running(wm, owner, type, exclude_flags): running or suspended jobs of a type, any owner (only this function of the commit)

5.3.why: Blender 5.3 ships the same function (16859984917c) and removes WM_jobs_has_running_type and the one-argument WM_jobs_has_running; the 1.1 merge keeps 5.3's definition, no caller of the removed two remains. Same loop over the jobs: no latency or cost change.
